**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Extend the route deadline with the browser budget**

When a cold start or challenge handling takes more than 20 seconds, the proposed 90-second provider deadline will never take effect: the current `productAcquisitionRoutes` still wraps every route with `RequestTimeout: sourcing.AcquisitionTimeout`, so its parent context cancels the request at 20 seconds. D2 discusses changing the service deadline and checking the body-read timeout but does not require changing the route deadline or allocating separate browser and publication budgets. This blocks the current Must of submitting a link and receiving the published product in exactly the scenario motivating D2; classify it as `BLOCKER` (core happy path cannot complete) and define the transport plus per-stage deadlines before implementation.

**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Admit public_browser in persisted command validation**

The server-browser operation has an empty `CaptureSHA256`, and `Repository.StartPrepared` calls `validCommand`, whose non-capture branch currently accepts only `metadata["channel"] == "public_http"`. Adding `public_browser` only to `MapAcquisitionEvidence`, as specified here, therefore makes every browser command fail with `ErrInvalidAcquisition` before publication and also leaves persisted-command recovery unable to validate it. This is a `BLOCKER` for the core happy path; explicitly include the persistence command/recovery allow-list in the contract change.

**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Enforce the browser outbound network boundary**

When the loaded page redirects or embeds a request to another host, Chromium follows it by default; the legacy browser code selected for extraction has no request-interception guard, while the current HTTP provider revalidates every redirect. Merely stating that the browser “must only access” 1688 does not enforce this, so a remote page can cause the service to issue requests to loopback, link-local, private-network, or otherwise unapproved destinations. This is a `BLOCKER` at the new cross-system security boundary; define request interception that validates every navigation and subresource destination, blocks non-public resolved addresses, and allows only the explicitly required public 1688/CDN origins.

**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Enforce IP checks at the browser's actual egress**

When an allowed hostname resolves or is rebound to a private address, `BrowserContext.Route`/`Page.Route` cannot enforce the stated check against the actual connection: the route callback runs before Chromium resolves the destination, while the checked-in playwright-go API exposes the peer address only through `Response.ServerAddr` after the request has already escaped. The prior comment requested enforceable request interception; the fresh evidence is that the selected Playwright API cannot bind a separate DNS lookup to Chromium's socket, leaving a TOCTOU SSRF bypass. Use a controlled proxy/dial/firewall boundary that validates the connection target, also accounting for service-worker and WebSocket traffic. Classification: `BLOCKER` because this bypasses the explicit outbound access-control boundary and blocks production wiring for the current Must.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Replay persisted operations before launching the browser**

When the first POST commits through `StartPrepared` or publishes but its response is lost, retrying that POST with the same key follows this mandated ordering and launches a fresh browser before consulting the durable operation. If 1688 is then challenged or unavailable, the retry fails at the provider instead of returning the already recoverable result, contradicting D6's same-key replay guarantee and repeating an external side effect. Add an authorized `ByKey`/resolve fast path before acquisition, proceeding to the browser only on a confirmed not-found result, and cover response-loss plus concurrent retries. Classification: `IMPLEMENTATION_TEST`; the affected Must is idempotent replay, and this blocks final implementation validation for POST retry/recovery.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Treat invalid server evidence as a source failure**

When a valid 1688 URL produces malformed evidence because the page shape changed or the new extractor omitted a required field, `MapAcquisitionEvidence` is rejecting server-generated output, not client input, so projecting that error as HTTP 400 `INVALID_ACQUISITION` incorrectly tells the user their request is invalid. The existing public acquisition flow passes mapper errors through `failFetch` and returns 502 `SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE`; the new pre-`StartPrepared` path should preserve the distinction between request validation and provider/parser failure. Classification: `IMPLEMENTATION_TEST`; this affects the current Must to report acquisition failure truthfully and blocks final user-path verification.

**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Mark the superseded batch clauses at their source**

The decision is declared `APPROVED / ACTIVE`, but the referenced batch design still repeatedly states that CAPTCHA handling must remain manual and that server-side anonymous acquisition must not be restored—for example at lines 27 and 41–43—without a supersession marker or link to this decision. Deferring the update leaves directly conflicting active guidance discoverable and allows the withdrawn requirement to be reapplied during implementation; update those exact clauses while retaining their historical text. Classification: `BACKLOG`; this does not itself break the runtime path, but it must be resolved as repository-authority maintenance before the design is promoted.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Separate request-body and route deadlines**

When a client uploads the small JSON body slowly, this requirement expands `WithRequestBodyReadTimeout` to the full browser-plus-publication budget even though `internal/httproute/request_body.go:13-23` uses that timer specifically to interrupt a blocked body read; meanwhile the route deadline starts before that read, so most or all of the provider budget can be consumed before acquisition begins. This both weakens the existing slow-body resource bound and can still produce `DEADLINE_EXCEEDED` after a valid body arrives. Keep a short independent body-read timeout and size the total route deadline to include body read, browser, and publication budgets. Classification: `IMPLEMENTATION_TEST`; this affects the Must to submit a link and receive the published product and blocks final deadline/resource-boundary validation.

**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Give publication a separate service-stage deadline**

When navigation or challenge handling legitimately consumes most of `BrowserAcquisitionTimeout`, this proposed service timeout expires before `Claim`/`Publish`/exact read because the current `AcquisitionService.Acquire` uses one child context around the entire method. A larger route deadline cannot rescue that canceled child, so a browser acquisition that completes within its budget can still fail during publication. Classification: `BLOCKER` because the submit-to-published happy path cannot complete at the documented budget boundary; include publication in the outer service budget and apply the browser timeout only to a provider subcontext.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L154-L164](https://github.com/qq550723504/task-processor/blob/040975c893acc38ad9b1b81f1ec6f6f7f1dc8482/AGENTS.md#L154-L164)

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**已修（finding #9，BLOCKER）**。核实 `internal/app/productsourcing/acquisition.go:31` 用**一个** child context 包住整个 `Acquire`，`resolve`（Claim/Publish/exact read）用的就是它——直接把 provider 预算设成 90s 会让采集成功但发布阶段拿到已到期 context，route deadline 再大也救不了。已把 D2 改为**两层预算**：外层 = provider + 发布，浏览器预算只施加于 provider **子 context**。并记明已核实采集路由白名单只断言 method+path（`current_application.go:487-492`），改超时不会碰 guard。§8 增加「provider 用满预算但发布仍完成」验收。

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Coordinate same-key admission before launching Chromium**

When two first-time POSTs with the same key overlap, both callers can observe `ByKey` as not found and both launch a browser; `StartPrepared` arbitrates only after both outbound acquisitions have occurred. The fresh evidence beyond the prior replay comment is this check/admission gap, which means the stated concurrent-retry guarantee cannot be enforced and can duplicate expensive requests that worsen the accepted shared-IP risk. Classification: `IMPLEMENTATION_TEST`; add minimal same-key coordination before acquisition and test the simultaneous-not-found case, not only retries after a row already exists.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L154-L164](https://github.com/qq550723504/task-processor/blob/040975c893acc38ad9b1b81f1ec6f6f7f1dc8482/AGENTS.md#L154-L164)

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**已修（finding #10，IMPLEMENTATION_TEST）**。成立：`ByKey` 只挡“已有行”，两个**首次并发**同 key POST 会同时 not found 并各启一次浏览器。已在 D1 增加**同 key 准入协调**（按 `(scope,key)` singleflight/互斥），并明确协调只为省掉重复出网，正确性仍依赖 `StartPrepared` 原子性（多副本下也如此）。§8 验收新增“并发首次同 key”。

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Update the authoritative SRC-2B1 contract now**

This section promises a minimal architecture-stage revision, but the commit leaves `docs/engineering/src2b-public-acquisition.md` unchanged: it still defines the provider as static `window.context` parsing rather than browser capture and fixes the operation deadline at 20 seconds, while D1/D2/D11 introduce a browser path, new failure semantics, a new channel, and longer budgets. The fresh evidence relative to the prior batch-design comment is that the batch source was updated but this other explicitly named authority was not, leaving implementation with conflicting active instructions. Classification: `BACKLOG`; revise or explicitly supersede the affected SRC-2B1 clauses before promoting this design.

**已修（finding #11，BACKLOG）**。成立。已在 `docs/engineering/src2b-public-acquisition.md` 头部加**定向暂停说明**：仅对浏览器 provider 暂停静态-HTML 专用条款（`window.context`-only parser、8s GET/20s operation deadline、单一 provider 措辞），并列出替换项（`public_browser` channel + `validCommand` 白名单、provider 子预算且外层含发布、ByKey 先重放、服务端证据失败报 `SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE`）。**identity/证据语义/SRC-1/Catalog/幂等/重放/COMMIT-unknown/授权/上限/不登录前提对两个 provider 均继续生效**。

**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Keep Chromium's process off the acquisition database**

When the acquisition process is deployed literally with the shared `product_acquisition` database, its network namespace must permit database egress, and Chromium in that same container inherits that reachability. This contradicts D12's requirement that the browser process cannot access internal databases; the URL-level Playwright interception is explicitly not a trusted control, so it cannot restore the claimed isolation. Keep database credentials and connectivity in `current-application` and make the acquisition process RPC-only, or specify an enforceable process-level network boundary. Classification: `BLOCKER` because the stated production rollout cannot safely satisfy its explicit outbound access-control gate.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L154-L164](https://github.com/qq550723504/task-processor/blob/54acd01ecc02fa94b74e81a3aa9c088bd2fe53c4/AGENTS.md#L154-L164)

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**已修（finding #12，BLOCKER）——这条指出了我自己引入的矛盾，成立**。首版 D13 写“采集进程复用同一个 `product_acquisition` 库”是错的：进程持库 → 网络命名空间必须放行 DB → 同容器 Chromium 继承可达性 → D12「浏览器不得访问内网 DB」失效，而 URL 层拦截已被降为不可单独依赖，补不了洞。已重写 D13：采集进程改为**无凭据 evidence 生产者（RPC-only）**——无任何 DB 凭据/无 DB 网络可达、不写操作行、不做授权判断；`current-application` 保留全部库、授权与发布。D12 由此**结构性成立**，并新增可观测门禁「采集进程无法连到任何内网 DB」。RPC 入参不含 org/actor/roles/token。

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Bound evidence before materializing it across RPC**

When an untrusted page supplies an extremely large variants, images, or attributes subtree, both `page.Evaluate`/Playwright and the internal RPC must materialize that data before `MapAcquisitionEvidence` or `MaxAcquisitionCommandBytes` can reject it. The cited 2 MiB command limit therefore does not bound browser/CDP/RPC memory and a crafted or changed page can exhaust the acquisition process. Define page-side collection/byte limits and an RPC message limit that apply before decoding, then cover an oversized fixture. Classification: `IMPLEMENTATION_TEST`; this affects acquisition availability and blocks final resource-boundary validation.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L163-L164](https://github.com/qq550723504/task-processor/blob/54acd01ecc02fa94b74e81a3aa9c088bd2fe53c4/AGENTS.md#L163-L164)

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**已修（finding #13，IMPLEMENTATION_TEST）**。成立：CDP `page.Evaluate` 与 RPC 都会先反序列化进内存，之后 `MaxAcquisitionCommandBytes` 才拒绝。已在 D8 增加**物化前限长**：页内取数即对每个集合施加条目/字节上限（超限作 source_too_large 类失败而非静默截断），RPC 侧用 `io.LimitReader` 在解码前硬限长。§8 增加超大 variants/images/attributes fixture 验收。

**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Authenticate callers of the collector RPC**

When the collector shares an internal network with any workload other than `current-application`, relying on internal reachability while deliberately carrying no token lets that workload invoke Chromium without the verified identity and `product_sourcing.write` gate required by D7. Keeping tenant credentials out of the RPC is correct, but the design still needs a service identity or an ingress policy that admits only `current-application`; otherwise the new RPC bypasses the explicit access-control boundary and can consume the collector/IP budget. Classification: `BLOCKER` (绕过明确的访问控制); this affects the authorized-acquisition Must and blocks production wiring.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L103-L108](https://github.com/qq550723504/task-processor/blob/87b7aa1783f2b6484a3d1aaff3ef732472239c29/AGENTS.md#L103-L108)

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**已修（finding #14，BLOCKER）**。成立：我把“不带租户凭据”写对了，但**只靠内部网络可达 = 没有调用方认证**。已核实现有采集路由带 `AuthPolicyVerifiedIdentity` + `OrganizationAccessPolicyLiveWrite` + `Permission: product_sourcing.write`，而采集 RPC 刻意不带这些；若同网络内任何工作负载都能调用，就绕过了 D7 授权门禁并可任意消耗共享浏览器/IP 预算。另已核实**仓库当前无可复用的 mTLS / 服务身份机制**。已在 D13 要求**可执行的调用方准入**（网络准入：RPC 端口只对 `current-application` 命名空间/主机开放；或服务身份：mTLS/独立服务凭据），要求**可观测验证**（未授权来源被拒）并列为**部署门禁**；并写明该控制是**服务间认证**，不引入租户身份/用户凭据。§8 增加对应验收。

**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Enforce operation capacity before browser acquisition**

When an organization has already reached either the 2048 retained-operation ceiling or the 32-active-operation limit, `ByKey` still returns not found for every new key and this ordering launches Chromium before `StartPrepared` performs the capacity check. Each request therefore consumes the shared browser/IP budget and only then returns `ACQUISITION_CAPACITY`, and unique keys can repeat this indefinitely despite the document saying existing limits remain in force. Add a bounded pre-acquisition capacity admission/check while retaining `StartPrepared` as the atomic correctness gate. Classification: `IMPLEMENTATION_TEST`; this affects the current resource-limit Must and blocks final capacity-path validation.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L163-L164](https://github.com/qq550723504/task-processor/blob/87b7aa1783f2b6484a3d1aaff3ef732472239c29/AGENTS.md#L163-L164)

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**已修（finding #15，IMPLEMENTATION_TEST）**。成立：已核实容量检查只在 `StartPrepared` 内（`repository.go:165,221`），而 `ByKey` 对新 key 总返回 not found ⇒ 已触顶组织的新 key 会**先启浏览器**、耗掉共享 IP 预算，然后才拿到 `ACQUISITION_CAPACITY`。已在 D1 增加**抓取前有界容量预检/准入**，并明确 `StartPrepared` 仍是原子正确性栅栏（预检与抓取之间的竞态由它兜住）。§8 增加“已触顶组织的新 key 不得先启浏览器”验收。

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Compare the stored source before replaying**

When a caller reuses an existing idempotency key with a different offer, this prescribed fast path goes from `ByKey` directly to resolve/read without requiring `sameAcquisition(request, op)` (the comparison currently performed by `Acquire` and `Verify`). The request can therefore receive the product stored for the old offer instead of the required `ErrAcquisitionConflict`. Require the fingerprint/source comparison before resolving any hit. Classification: `IMPLEMENTATION_TEST`; this affects the same-key/different-payload idempotency Must and blocks replay-path validation.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L159-L160](https://github.com/qq550723504/task-processor/blob/87b7aa1783f2b6484a3d1aaff3ef732472239c29/AGENTS.md#L159-L160)

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**已修（finding #16，IMPLEMENTATION_TEST）**。成立。已核实 `sameAcquisition` 比对 `Fingerprint` 与 `Source`（`internal/app/productsourcing/acquisition.go`）并返回 `ErrAcquisitionConflict`；我写的快速路径确实漏了它。已在 D1 要求 `ByKey` 命中后**必须先比较**再 resolve/read——同 key 换 offer 必须冲突，**不得**把旧 offer 的已发布结果返回给新请求。§8 增加“同 key 异 offer”验收。

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Bound browser network responses as well as evidence**

When an allowed 1688/CDN origin returns a very large document or subresource, Chromium materializes it before the page-side evidence cap in the following lines runs. `MaxAcquisitionCommandBytes` only bounds the later publication command, so it does not preserve the active contract's compressed/expanded provider-body limits or prevent an allowed origin from exhausting collector memory/bandwidth. Define navigation/subresource response and aggregate download limits at the browser/proxy boundary, not only limits on the extracted JSON. Classification: `IMPLEMENTATION_TEST`; this affects acquisition availability and blocks final resource-boundary validation.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L163-L164](https://github.com/qq550723504/task-processor/blob/87b7aa1783f2b6484a3d1aaff3ef732472239c29/AGENTS.md#L163-L164)

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**已修（finding #17，IMPLEMENTATION_TEST）**。成立。已核实 `src2b-acquisition-v1` 已有“压缩/展开后各限 2 MiB”上限（`docs/engineering/src2b-public-acquisition.md:54`），该上限必须**带到浏览器路径**：被允许 origin 的超大文档/子资源会在页内证据上限之前被 Chromium 物化，`MaxAcquisitionCommandBytes` 只管后续 command。已在 D8 要求在**浏览器/代理边界**定义**单响应上限 + 累计下载上限**，超限即中止该次采集（不静默继续）；§8 增加超大响应 fixture 验收。§11 新增“响应/累计下载上限数值需与 2 MiB 语义对齐后定稿”。

**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Remove the collector's stale database ownership**

When an implementer follows this scope statement, the collector reuses `product_acquisition`, requiring database credentials and network reachability in the same namespace as Chromium; this directly defeats D12's isolation and contradicts D13's corrected RPC-only collector. The fresh evidence beyond the previously resolved finding is that this earlier clause still explicitly assigns the database to the collector. Classification: `BLOCKER` because the resulting rollout cannot safely enforce the new outbound security boundary; this affects the anonymous-acquisition Must and blocks production wiring until the clause is aligned with D13.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L17-L20](https://github.com/qq550723504/task-processor/blob/4f72b07524c4d5543d9e8ae385d8d7bdb2c6df57/AGENTS.md#L17-L20)

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**已修（finding #18，BLOCKER）**。成立——这是 finding #12 的旧病灶，我在 D13 改了却漏了 §1 范围声明，实施者照做仍会把库凭据与 Chromium 放进同一网络命名空间。已把 §1 对齐 D13：**所有数据库（含 `product_acquisition`）仅由 `current-application` 持有，采集进程无任何库凭据、无库网络可达**；§4 调用链也补了同一句。已核实文档中不再有第二处把库指派给采集进程的表述（D13 里那一处是明确标注“首版是错的”的修正记录）。

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Define the capacity preflight contract**

When an organization is already at the retained or active-operation ceiling, this preflight cannot currently be implemented through `AcquisitionOperationStore`: the only capacity count is private inside `Repository.StartPrepared`, while §7 explicitly says the store interface will not change. The fresh evidence beyond the prior capacity finding is this missing contract path, so following the design still leaves no way to reject before launching Chromium. Define and wire a minimal capacity-reader/admission contract while retaining `StartPrepared` as the atomic gate. Classification: `IMPLEMENTATION_TEST`; this affects the existing resource-limit Must and blocks final validation of the capped-organization request path.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Claim prepared operations before resolving replay**

When `StartPrepared` commits but the process or response is lost before `Claim`, `ByKey` returns a `prepared` operation. Sending that state directly to the existing resolve/read logic cannot recover it: `AcquisitionService.resolve` accepts only `publishing` or `published`, so every same-key retry returns `OUTCOME_UNKNOWN` and no scheduler will advance the durable command. Fresh evidence beyond the prior replay finding is this explicit state check in the current resolver. Require the fast path to claim a `prepared` operation before resolving it. Classification: `IMPLEMENTATION_TEST`; this affects idempotent response-loss recovery and blocks final validation of that path.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Recheck the key after admission coordination**

When an organization has exactly one retained or active-operation slot left, two first-time requests for the same key can both miss the initial `ByKey`; the leader then consumes the final slot, while a mutex-based waiter proceeds to the newly added capacity preflight and receives `ACQUISITION_CAPACITY` instead of replaying the leader’s operation. Require waiters to rerun `ByKey` plus `sameAcquisition` after acquiring coordination, or have singleflight share the completed operation, before applying the capacity check. Classification: `IMPLEMENTATION_TEST`; this affects the same-key concurrency/idempotency Must and blocks validation of the near-capacity retry path.

Finding: Recheck the key after admission coordination
Product requirement affected: same-key idempotency must return the leader outcome, not a spurious capacity failure, for a caller arriving when the organization is at its last slot.
Classification: IMPLEMENTATION_TEST — confirmed real and fixed.
Reason: reproduced. The waiter blocked on the same-key mutex and then went straight to the capacity preflight. When the leader had just consumed the final slot, the preflight denied and the waiter returned ACQUISITION_CAPACITY even though a replayable operation for its own key already existed — a misleading failure for a request the user had already successfully issued once.
Action: after acquiring coordination the caller now re-runs ByKey plus sameAcquisition and replays when the leader completed, before any capacity check. Added TestBrowserAcquireSameKeyWaiterReplaysInsteadOfCapacityError, which is red without the fix (waiter gets acquisition resource limit reached, replayed=false) and green with it: exactly one provider call, both callers observe the same operation ID in AcquisitionPublished. The test store double also had to start persisting the StartPrepared row, since without that ByKey could never observe the leader operation and the replay path was untestable.
